verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document plan-based daily task quotas or concurrency caps, and gives no way to view or manage such limits. The pricing page lists only plan features (unlimited users, remote access, automations), and the concurrent-session dashboard is monitoring, not limit management. Pricing limits are a fair axis for this kind of product, so the absence of evidence means none, not na.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can see and manage plan-based daily task and concurrency limits for agent workflows
